If sentiment is positive in the last 3 days and forecast is trending up, reduce late-period forecast by 1.5–2.5% to avoid over-optimism.  
If sentiment is negative in the last 3 days and forecast is trending down, increase late-period forecast by 1.5–2.5% to counteract pessimism.  
If sentiment is neutral and forecast is flat, adjust mid-period forecast upward by 0.5–1.0% to reflect latent upward momentum.  
If sentiment swings from negative to positive within 5 days, shift forecast midpoint upward by 1.0–1.5% to capture sentiment reversal.  
If forecast consistently underestimates true values in early period (first 7 days), apply a +0.8–1.2% bias to early forecast to correct for lagged sentiment.  
If forecast consistently overestimates true values in late period (last 7 days), apply a -0.8–1.2% bias to late forecast to correct for overconfidence.
